nodes.title: Relight IC-LoRA — directions, prompts, trigger
widgets_values:
RELIGHT IC-LoRA

Set the light direction on the Sphere Light Render node.
Works best on footage with no strong existing light direction
(overcast skies or indoor footage).

PROMPT:
  relight the video to match the light-direction ball. <look> from <direction>

  <direction> = the front / front-right / right / back-right /
                behind / back-left / left / front-left

EXAMPLES:
  ...ball. hard directional sunlight from the right
  ...ball. warm golden low sun from the front
  ...ball. strong backlight with rim light from behind

LIGHT LOOKS (pick one for <look>):
  hard directional sunlight
  hard high-angle sunlight
  hard low-angle sunlight
  soft diffused daylight
  soft warm afternoon light
  cool soft daylight
  dim overcast light
  strong backlight with rim light
  soft hazy backlight
  warm golden low front sun
  warm golden low side sun
  frontal sunlight
 
Tip: one light setup per clip. Match the words to the ball - don't describe the scene.
